English: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is one of the most important livestock diseases restricting international trade.
Luganda: Obulwadde bwa kalusu (FMD) bwe bumu ku bulwadde bw’ensolo obusinga obukulu mu kulemesa obusuubuzi mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Àrùn ẹsẹ̀-àti-ẹnu (FMD) jẹ́ ọ̀kàn pàtàkì nínú àwọn àrùn ohun-ọ̀sìn tí ó ń ṣe ìdíwọ́ òwò.
Zulu: Isifo somlomo nomlomo (FMD) singesinye sezifo ezibaluleke kakhulu zemfuyo ezivimbela ukuhwebelana kwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: Cutar ƙafa da baki (FMD) na ɗaya daga cikin mahimman cututtukan dabbobi da suke hana kasuwancin ƙasa-da-ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bja hlako-le-molomo (FMD) ke bjo bongwe bja malwetši a bohlokwa kudukudu bja leruo bjo bo šitišago kgwebišano ya boditšhabatšhaba.
Amharic: የእግር-እና-የአፍ በሽታ (ኤፍኤምዲ) የአለም አቀፍ ንግድን ከሚገድቡ በጣም አስፈላጊ የእንስሳት በሽታዎች መካከል አንዱ ነው።

English: While it is clear that African buffalo (Syncerus caffer) act as the main wildlife reservoir, viral and immune response dynamics during FMD virus acute infection have not been described before in this species.
Luganda: Newankubadde kimanyiddwa bulungi nti embogo za Africa (Syncerus caffer) kye kisolo ekisinga okuwangaaliramu obuwuka, enneeyisa y’obuwuka n’obusibage mu kiseera ky’okulumbibwa akawuka ka FMD ow’amaanyi tebinoonyerezebwangako mu kisobolo kino.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí ó hàn kedere pé ẹfọ̀n ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà (Syncerus caffer) ń ṣe gẹ́gẹ́ bí àléélẹ̀ ẹran igbó, èsì ajẹmọ́kòkòrò àti àjẹsára lásìkò FMD fún ìkóràn ògidì kòkòrò àìsàn kò tíì di ohun tí wọ́n ṣàlàyé rẹ̀ nínú ̀wọn ẹ̀yá-ẹ̀dá yìí.
Zulu: Nakuba kusobala ukuthi inyathi yase-Afrika (i-Syncerus caffer) isebenza njengendawo yokugcina izilwane zasendle, amandla okusabela ngegciwane kanye nokuzivikela komzimba ngesikhathi sokutheleleka ngegciwane le-FMD awakachazwa ngaphambili kulolu hlobo.
Hausa: Duk da yake a fili yake cewa ɓauna ta Afirka (Syncerus caffer) tana aiki a matsayin babbar da ta mamaye namun daji, ba a bayyana haɓakar ƙwayoyin cuta da amsawar garkuwar jiki a lokaci a yayin kamuwa da cutar ƙwayar cutar FMD a baya ba a cikin wannan jinsin.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le molaleng gore dinare tša Afrika (Syncerus caffer) di bonwa bjalo ka mothopo wo bohlokwa wa diphedišoka, mathata a baerale le boitšhireletšo bja mmele nakong ya phetetšo ye šoro ya baerase ya FMD ga se a hlalošwa peleng go mohuta wo.
Amharic: የአፍሪካ ጎሽ (ሲንኬረስ ካፌር) እንደ ዋና የዱር አራዊት ማከማቻ እንደሚያገለግል ግልጽ ቢሆንም፣ በኤፍኤምዲ አጣዳፊ ቫይረስ ወቅት የቫይረስ እና የበሽታ መቋቋም አቅም ምላሽ ተለዋዋጭነት በዚህ ዝርያዎች ውስጥ ከዚህ ቀደም አልተገለጸም።

English: We used experimental needle inoculation and contact infections with three Southern African Territories serotypes to assess clinical, virological and immunological dynamics for thirty days post infection.
Luganda: Twakozesa enkola y’okukuba ebisolo obuwuka mu mpiso n’okuleka ensolo okusiiga zinnaazo n’obuwuka busatu obw’omu mawanga g’Obukiikaddyo bwa Africa okwekaliriza enneeyisa yaabwo okumala ennaku amakumi asatu oluvannyuma lw’okukwata embogo.
Yoruba: A lo ìlànà àṣedánwò fífí abẹ́rẹ́ kó ohun wọ inú ara àti àwọn ìkóràn ìkanra pẹ̀lú sẹ́rótáìpù ààlà ilẹ̀ Apá Gúúsù Áfíríkà mẹ́ta láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìlànà, ajẹmọ́tọ̀ọ́jú, ajẹmọ́kòkòrò, àti ajẹmọ́àjẹsára fún ọgbọ̀n ọjọ́ lẹ́yìn ìkóràn.
Zulu: Sasebenzisa ukujova inaliti yokuhlola kanye nezifo zokuthintana nama-serotypes amathathu e-Southern African Territories ukuze sihlole ukuguquguquka kwemitholampilo, i-virological kanye ne-immunology izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokutheleleka.
Hausa: Mun yi amfani da allura ta gwaji da cututtuka na ɗauka tare da mabambanta na Yankuna uku na Kudancin Afirka domin tantance yanayi na asibiti, ƙwayoyin cuta da haɓakar garguwar jiki na kwanaki talatin bayan kamuwa da cuta.
Northern Sotho: Re šomišitše moento wa tšhwaana wa go dira diteko le diphetetšo tša go kgomagana ka diserothaepe tše tharo tša Southern African Territories go lekola mathata a tša diteko tša kalafo, baerolotšikhale le imunolotšikhale tekano ya matšatši a masometharo morago ga phetetšo.
Amharic: ከኢንፌክሽኑ በኋላ ለሰላሳ ቀናት ያህል ክሊኒካዊ፣ ቫይሮሎጂካዊ እና የበሽታ መቋቋም አቅም ምላሻዊ ለውጦችን ለመገምገም የሙከራ መርፌ መከተብን እና ከሶስት የደቡብ አፍሪካ ግዛቶች በባክቴሪያ ወይም በቫይረስ ዝርያ ውስጥ ያሉ ልዩነቶች ወይም ቡድኖች ጋር የንክኪ ኢንፌክሽኖችን ተጠቀምን።

English: Clinical FMD in the needle inoculated buffaloes was mild and characterised by pyrexia.
Luganda: FMD ajjanjabwa mu mbogo ezikubwa empiso y’eddagala erigema yali mutono era ng’alimu omusujja.
Yoruba: FMD ajẹ́mọ́tọ̀ọ́jú lára àwọn ẹfọ̀n tí wọ́n fi abẹrẹ́ fa nǹkan wọnu ara wọn kò gbópọn ara gbígbóná sì ni ó pọ̀ jù.
Zulu: I-FMD yomtholampilo ezinyathi ezifakwe inaliti yayimnene futhi ibonakala nge-pyrexia.
Hausa: FMD na asibiti a cikin allurar ɓaunayen yana da laushi kuma yana da tashin zafin jiki mai yawa.
Northern Sotho: FMD ya klinikhale ka go dinare tše di hlabetšwego tšhwaana e bile magareng le go lemogwa ka phaerešiya.
Amharic: ክሊኒካዊ ኤፍኤምዲ በመርፌ የተከተቡ ጎሾች ገር እና በትኩሳት የሚለዩ ነበሩ።

English: Despite the absence of generalised vesicles, all contact animals were readily infected with their respective serotypes within the first 2-9 days after being mixed with needle challenged buffaloes.
Luganda: Newankubadde nga tewaaliwo buzimbazimba obw’awamu, ensolo zonna ezaasemberegana zaafuna obuwuka obubutuukirako mu nnaku 2-9 ezisooka oluvannyuma lw’okwetabula n’embogo ezaakubwa empiso.
Yoruba: Nípa pé kò sí àpapọ̀ àwọn àpò omira, gbogbo ̀wọn ẹrnko tí wọ́n kanra ni wọ́n ni wọ́n ní ìkóràn irú sẹ́rótáìpù wọn láàrin ọjọ́ 2-9 àkọ́kọ́ lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n dà wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ àwọn ẹfọ̀n tí wọ́n ní ìpèníjà abẹ́rẹ́.
Zulu: Naphezu kokungabikho kwama-vesicles ajwayelekile, zonke izilwane ezixhumene nazo zangenwa kalula ama-serotypes azo phakathi kwezinsuku zokuqala ezingu-2-9 ngemva kokuhlanganiswa nezinyathi ezinenselelo enaliti.
Hausa: Duk da rashin ƙuraje gabaɗaya, duk dabbobin suka kamu sun kamu da saurin kamuwa da mabambanta daban-daban a cikin kwanaki 2 zuwa 9 na farko bayan an haɗe su da allurar ɓaunaye masu fama.
Northern Sotho: Ntle le go se be gona ga maphone ao a akareditšwego, diphoofolo ka moka tša kgomagano di be di šetše di feteditšwe ka diserothaepe tša tšona matšatšing a mathomo a 2-9 morago ga go hlakanywa le dinare tše di tšhabanago le tšhwaana.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳን አጠቃላይ በህብረ ህዋስ ሽፋን የሚፈጠሩ በፈሳሽ ያዘሉ ትናንሽ ከረጢቶች ባይኖሩም፣ ሁሉም የተነካኩ እንስሳት በመርፌ ከተሞከሩ ጎሾች ጋር ከተቀላቀሉ በኋላ በመጀመሪያዎቹ 2-9 ቀናት ውስጥ በየራሳቸው በቫይረስ ዝርያ ውስጥ ያሉ ልዩነቶች ወይም ቡድኖች ተይዘዋል።

English: Irrespective of the route of infection or serotype there were positive associations between the viral loads in blood and the induction of host innate pro-inflammatory cytokines and acute phase proteins.
Luganda: Awatali kufa ku kkubo lya buwuka, waaliwo akakwate wakati w’omuwendo gw’obuwuka mu musaayi n’okussibwamu puloteni za cytokines ezireeta okuzimba ne puloteni ez’omutendera ogw’amaanyi.
Yoruba: Láìní ohunkóhun ṣe pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà tí ìkóràn gbà wá tàbí sẹ́rótáìpù àṣepọ̀ gidi wà láàrin iye kòkòrò tí ó wà nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ àti ìdarapọ̀mọ́ olùgbalèjò àbímọ́ àti wíwú potéènì aṣèrànwọ́ àjẹsára àti ògidì ojú potéènì.
Zulu: Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umzila wokutheleleka noma i-serotype kwakukhona izinhlangano ezinhle phakathi kwemithwalo yegciwane egazini kanye nokungeniswa kwama-cytokines angenayo i-innate pro-inflammatory kanye nama-acute phase protein.
Hausa: Ba tare da la’akari da hanyar kamuwa da cuta ko bambanci ba akwai alaƙoƙi masu kyau a tsakanin tarin ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jini da kuma ƙaddamar da ƙananan furotin masu sarrafa kumburi na garkuwar jiki da kuma furotin masu raguwa yayin kumburi.
Northern Sotho: Go sa lebelelwe tsela ya phetetšo goba serothaepe go bile le dikamantšho tše di thabišago magareng ga dikelo tša baerale ka mading le tšweletšo ya disaethokhine tše di bakago go kokomoga ga bokagare bja monggae le diprotheine nakong ya seemo se šoro.
Amharic: የኢንፌክሽን ወይም በቫይረስ ዝርያ ውስጥ ያሉ ልዩነቶች ወይም ቡድኖች መንገድ ምንም ይሁን ምን በደም ውስጥ ባሉ የቫይረስ ጭነቶች እና በተቀባዩ ውስጣዊ እብጠት አምጪ የደም ህዋሳትን የሚቆጣጠሩ ፕሮቲኖች እና የአጣዳፊ ደረጃ ፕሮቲኖች መካከል አዎንታዊ ግንኙነቶች ነበሩ።

English: Viral loads in blood and tonsils were tightly correlated during the acute phase of the infection, however, viraemia significantly declined after a peak at 4 days post infection (dpi), which correlated with the presence of detectable neutralising antibodies.
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’obuwuka mu musaayi n’emimiro zaageraageranyizibwa mu mutendera ogw’amaanyi ogw’obulwadde, wabula, viraemia yakendeera nnyo oluvannyuma lw’entikko nga wayise ennaku 4 okuva ku kufuna obulwadde (dpi), nga kino kyali kikwatagana n’okubeerawo kwa antibody ezikkakkanya ezirabika.
Yoruba: Ìye kòkòrò tí ó wà nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ àti àwọn ẹ̀gbẹ́ ahọ́n ní wọ́n ní ètò tímọ́tímọ́ ní ìpelè ìgbà tí ìkóràn náà jẹ́ ògidì, àmọ́, kòkòrò inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ dínkù gidi gan-an lẹ́yìn tí ó dé òtéńté ní ọjọ́ 4 lẹ́yìn ìkóràn (dpi), èyí í ó ṣe rẹ́gí pẹ̀lú wíwà àwọn sójà ara tí ó lè ṣe ìsọdọ̀lẹ́.
Zulu: Umthamo wegciwane egazini kanye namathoni ahlotshaniswa ngokuqinile phakathi nesigaba esibi kakhulu sokutheleleka, kodwa-ke, i-viraemia yehla kakhulu ngemva kokuphakama kwezinsuku ezi-4 ngemuva kokutheleleka (i-dpi), okuhlotshaniswa nokuba khona kwamasosha omzimba abonakala engathathi hlangothi.
Hausa: An haɗu da nauyin ƙwayar cuta a cikin jini da beli-beli sosai a lokacin babbar kamuwa da cuta, duk da haka, ƙwayar cutar hanyar jinin ta ragu sosai bayan ƙololuwar kwanaki 4 bayan kamuwa da cuta (dpi), wanda yake da alaƙa da kasancewar ƙwayoyin rigakafi mau sassautawa da za a iya ganowa.
Northern Sotho: Dikelo tša dibaerale ka mading le dithakeng di be di amantšhwa kudu nakong ya seemo se šoro sa phetetšo, le ge go le bjalo, biraemiya e fokotšegile kudu morago ga sehloa sa matšatši a 4 sa go hlabelwa ka tšhwaana (dpi), ye e amantšhitšwego le go hwetšagala ga dilwelammele tše di ka lemogegago tša go okobatša bogale.
Amharic: በደም እና በቶንሲሎች ውስጥ ያሉ የቫይረስ ጭነቶች በኢንፌክሽኑ አጣዳፊ ደረጃ ወቅት በጥብቅ የተቆራኙ ናቸው፣ ነገር ግን፣ ከበሽታው በኋላ ባሉት 4 ቀናት (ዲፒአይ) ላይ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ከደረሰ በኋላ የቫይረሱ የደም ውስጥ ዝውውር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል፣ ይህ ደግሞ ሊታወቁ የሚችሉ ለየት ያሉ ፀረ እንግዳ አካላት መኖር ጋር ይዛመዳል።

English: In contrast, infectious virus was isolated in the tonsils until the last sampling point (30 dpi) in most animals.
Luganda: Okwawukanako n’ekyo, akawuka akasiigibwa kaayawulwa mu mimiro okutuusa ku kiseera ky’okuggyako sampolo (30 dpi) mu nsolo ezisinga.
Yoruba: Ni ìyàtọ̀, àwọn kòkòrò aṣèkóràn jẹ́ yíyàsọ́tọ̀ ní àwọn ẹ̀gbẹ́ ahọ́n títí di òpin àyẹ̀wò (30 dpi) lára ọ̀pọ̀ ẹranko.
Zulu: Ngokuphambene, igciwane elithathelwanayo lahlukaniswa kumathoni kwaze kwaba yilapho isampula yokugcina (30 dpi) ezilwaneni eziningi.

Northern Sotho: Go fapana, baerase ye e fetelago e hlaotšwe ka gare ga dithaka go fihla go ntlha ya mafelelo ya go sampola (30 dpi) go bontši bja diphoofolo.
Amharic: በአንፃሩ፣ ኢንፌክሽን አምጪው ቫይረስ በአብዛኛዎቹ እንስሳት እስከ መጨረሻው የናሙና ነጥብ (30 ዲፒአይ) ድረስ በቶንሲል ውስጥ ተለይቷል።

English: The pattern of virus detection in serum and tonsil swabs was similar for all three serotypes in the direct challenged and contact challenged animals.

English: This study is the first to report that buffaloes exposed to foot and mouth disease virus (FMDV) can also develop symptoms such as a high body temperature, just like cattle.

Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše ke tša mathomo go bega gore dinare tše di lebane le bolwetši bja baerase ya hlako-le-molomo (FMDV) di ka itemogela le maswao a bjalo ka themphereitšha ya godimo ya mmele, go swana le dikgomo.

English: Doctors dealing with animal health issues can use this information to understand more about how buffaloes respond to infection by FMDV.

English: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) negatively affects the lives of many farmers in Africa because when there is an outbreak, farmers are unable to sell their cattle.

English: Researchers knew that buffaloes carry the FMDV, but they did not know much about how it affects them, as compared to cattle.

Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí mọ̀ pé àwọn ẹfọ̀n máa ń ní FMDV, àmọ́ wọñ kò nímọ̀ púpọ̀ nípa bí ó ṣe ń pa wọ́n lára, bí wọ́n bá ṣàfiwé rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú màlúù.

Luganda: Baakuba embogo z’omu bibinja 3 empiso z’ebika by’obuwuka bwa FMDV 3 (ebika biyitibwa AT1, SAT2 ne SAT3).
Yoruba: Wọ́n fún àwọn ẹfọ̀n tí ó wà nínú mẹ́ta nínú àwọn ọ̀wọ́ náà pẹ̀lú FMDV mẹ́ta ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ (wọ́n ń pe àwọn ẹ̀yà náà ní AT1, SAT2 àti SAT3).
Zulu: Bajova izinyathi emaqenjini ama-3 anezinhlobo ezi-3 ezahlukene ze-FMDV (lezi zinhlobo zibizwa nge-AT1, SAT2 kanye ne-SAT3).
Hausa: Sun yi wa ɓaunaye allurar a cikin rukunoni 3 na nau’o’in FMDV daban-daban guda 3 (ana kiran nau’o’in AT1 da SAT2 da kuma SAT3).
Northern Sotho: Ba hlabetše dinare ka go dihlopha tše 3 tša ditšhwana tše 3 tša mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya FMDV (mehuta ye e bitšwago AT1, SAT2 le SAT3).
Amharic: ከቡድኖቹ ውስጥ 3ቱን ጎሾች በ3 የተለያዩ ኤፍኤምዲቪ (አይነታቸው ኤቲ1፣ ኤስኤቲ2 እና ኤስኤቲ3 ይባላሉ) መርፌ ወግተዋል።

English: After 2 days, they allowed the injected buffaloes to mix (make contact) with those not injected with FMDV.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’ennaku 2, bakkiriza embogo ezikubiddwa obuwuka okwetabula (okukwatagana) n’ezo ezitakubiddwa kawuka ka FMDV.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ 2, wọ́n jẹ́ kí àwọn ẹfọ̀n tí wọ́n fún ní abẹ́rẹ́ náà láti dà pọ̀ (fara kan) pẹ̀lú àwọn tí wọn kò fi abẹ́rẹ́ fa FMDV sí lára.
Zulu: Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezi-2, bavumela izinyathi ezijovwe ukuthi zihlangane (zixhumane) nalezo ezingajovwe nge-FMDV.
Hausa: Bayan kwanaki 2, sun ba wa ɓaunayen da aka yi wa alluran gauraya (haɗuwa) da waɗanda ba a yi musu allurar FMDV ba.
Northern Sotho: Morago ga matšatši a 2, ba gapetše dinare tše di hlabetšwego ditšhwaana ka lešakeng le tee (go kopana) le tšeo di sego tša hlabelwa ka FMDV.
Amharic: ከ 2 ቀናት በኋላ፣ የተወጉት ጎሾች በኤፍኤምዲቪ ያልተወጉትን እንዲቀላቀሉ (ንክኪ እንዲፈጥሩ) ፈቅደዋል።

English: The researchers observed the buffaloes for 30 days.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beetegereza embogo okumala ennaku 30.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàkíyèsí àwọn ẹfọ̀n naà fún ọjọ 30.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babheka izinyathi izinsuku ezingu-30.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura da ɓaunayen na tsawon kwanaki 30.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lekodišišitše dinare tekano ya matšatši a 30.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ጎሾችን ለ30 ቀናት ተመልክተዋል።

English: They recorded their body temperatures and measured the amount of virus in their blood, throat and noses.
Luganda: Baawandiika ebbugumu ly’omubiri gwazo era ne bapima omuwendo gw’obuwuka mu musaayi gwazo, emimiro n’ennyindo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n se àkọsílẹ̀ gbígbóná ara wọ́n sì wọn iye kòkòrò tí ó wà nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ wọn, ọ̀fun àti imú wọn.
Zulu: Barekhoda izinga lokushisa lomzimba wabo futhi bakala inani legciwane egazini labo, umphimbo nasemakhaleni.
Hausa: Sun rubuta yanayin jikinsu kuma sun auna adadin ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jini da maƙogwaro da kuma hanci.
Northern Sotho: Ba ngwadile dithemphereitšha tša mebele ya tšona le go hwetša kelo ya baerase ka mading a tšona, mogolong le ka dinkong.
Amharic: የሰውነቶቻቸውን የሙቀት መጠኖች መዝግበው እና በደም፣ በጉሮሮ እና በአፍንጫዎች ውስጥ ያለውን የቫይረስ መጠን ለኩ።

English: They also checked for antibodies, which are special molecules that the body’s immune system produces to fight infection or disease caused by viruses, bacteria or other microorganisms.
Luganda: Era baakebera antibody, nga buno bwe busirikale obw’enjawulo obusibage bw’omubiri bwe bukola okulwanyisa obuvune oba obulwadde obuleetebwa obuwuka bwa virus, bakitiiriya oba obuwuka obulala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì tún wo àwọn sójà ara, ti wọ́n jẹ́ mólékù pàtàkì tí àjẹsára máa ń pèsè láti kojú ìkóràn tàbí àrùn tí àwọn kòkòrò, batéríà tàbi àwọn ohun àìfojúrí mìíràn ṣe okùnfà wọn.
Zulu: Baphinde bahlole amasosha omzimba, okungamamolekyuli akhethekile akhiqizwa amasosha omzimba ukuze alwe nokutheleleka noma izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane, amagciwane noma amanye amagciwane.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun bincika ƙwayoyin rigakafi, waɗanda su ne ƙwayoyin musamman waɗanda tsarin garkuwar jiki yake samarwa don yaƙar kamuwa da cuta ko cututtuka da ƙwayoyin cutada bakteriyoyi ko wasu ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta suke haifarwa.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekotše le dilwelammele, e lego dimolekhule tša go ikgetha tšeo di tšweletšwago ke maqole a mmele ya mmele wa tšona go lwantšha phetetšo goba bolwetši bjo bo bakwago ke dibaerase, dipaktheria goba diphedinyana tše dingwe.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የሰውነት በሽታ የመከላከል ስርዓት በቫይረሶች፣ በባክቴሪያ ወይም በሌሎች ረቂቅ ህዋሳት የሚመጡ በሽታዎችን ለመከላከል የሚያመነጨው ልዩ ሞለኪውሎች የሆኑትን፣ ፀረ እንግዳ አካላት ፈትሸዋል።

English: The researchers found that the injected buffaloes showed mild signs of FMD and a high body temperature (up to 39.5°C), which dropped after 4 days.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti embogo ezaakubwa empiso z’obuwuka zaafuna obubonera bw’obulwadde bwa FMD butono n’ebbugumu lingi (okutuuka ku 39.5°C), nga lino lyakendeera oluvannyuma lw’ennaku 4.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ríi pé àwọn ẹ̀fọ̀n tí wọn ò fún ní abẹ́rẹ́ ṣàfihàn àmì àìsàn FMD ráńpẹ́ àti ara gbígbóná (tí ó tó 39.5°C), èyí tí ó lọ ilẹ̀ lẹ́yìn ọdún mẹ́rin.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi izinyathi ezijovwe zabonisa izimpawu ezincane ze-FMD kanye nokushisa komzimba okuphezulu (kufika ku-39.5 ° C), okwehla ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-4.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa ɓaunayen da aka yi musu allura sun nuna alamun FMD matsakaici da kuma yanayin zafin jiki (har zuwa 39.5 ° C), wanda ya ragu bayan kwanaki 4.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore dinare tše di hlabetšwego tšhwaana di bontšhitše maswao a magareng a FMD le themphereitšha ya godimo ya mmele (go fihla go 39.5°C), yeo e theogilego morago ga matšatši a 4.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የተወጉ ጎሾች መለስተኛ የኤፍኤምዲ ምልክቶች እና ከ4 ቀናት በኋላ የቀነሰ፣ ከፍተኛ የሰውነት ሙቀትን (እስከ 39.5°C) አግኝተዋል።

English: They said 2 injected buffaloes had small blisters in their mouths.
Luganda: Baagamba nti embogo 2 ezaakubwa obuwuka zaalina obuzimba obutonotono mu kamwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé ẹfọ̀n méjì tí wọ́n fún ní abẹ́rẹ́ ní èépá díẹ̀ ní ẹnu wọn.
Zulu: Bathi izinyathi ezijovwe ezi-2 zazinamabhamuza amancane emlonyeni.
Hausa: Sun ce ɓaunaye guda 2 da aka yi musu allura suna da ƙananan kumburi a bakinsu.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore dinare tše 2 tše di hlabetšwego ka tšhwaana di bile le maphone a mannyane melomong ya tšona.
Amharic: 2 የተወጉ ጎሾች በአፋቸው ውስጥ ትናንሽ ውሃ የቋጠሩ ቁስሎች እንደነበሩ ተናግረዋል።

English: After 2-9 days of mixing, all non-injected buffaloes also got infected but did not develop any blisters.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’ennaku 2-9 ez’okubeera awamu, embogo zonna ezitaakubwamu buwuka nazo zaafuna obuwuka naye tezaafuna buzimba bwa ngeri yonna.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn dídàpọ̀ fún ọjọ́ 2-9, gbogbo àwọn ẹfọ̀n tí wọn kò fún ní abẹ́rẹ́ náà ní ìkóràn ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò ní èépá kankan lára.
Zulu: Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-2-9 zokuxuba, zonke izinyathi ezingajovwe nazo zangenwa izifo kodwa azizange zibe namabhamuza.
Hausa: Bayan kwanaki 2 zuwa 9 na gwamawar, duk ɓaunayen da ba a yi musu allura ba su ma sun kamu da cutar amma ba su samu wani kumburi ba.
Northern Sotho: Morago ga matšatši a 2-9 a go hlakanya, dinare ka moka tše di sa hlabelwago tšhwaana le tšona di feteditšwe eupša ga se tša ba le maphone afe goba afe.
Amharic: ከተቀላቀሉ ከ2-9 ቀናት በኋላ፣ ሁሉም ያልተወጉ ጎሾችም ተበክለዋል ነገር ግን ምንም አይነት ውሃ የቋጠሩ ቁስሎች አልተፈጠሩም።

English: Interestingly, the researchers found that buffaloes injected with virus type SAT2 were quick to have a high temperature and for longer periods.
Luganda: Ekyewuunyisa, abanoonyereza baakizuula nti embogo ezaakubwamu akawuka ak’ekika kya SAT2 zaayanguwa okufuna ebbugumu erya waggulu era lyalwawo.
Yoruba: Ohun tí ó dùn mọ́ni ni pé, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ríi pé àwọn ẹfọ̀n tí wọ́n fi abẹ́rẹ́ fa kòkòrò SAT2 sí lára yára ní ara gbígbóná fún ìgbà pípẹ́.
Zulu: Kuyathakazelisa ukuthi abacwaningi bathola ukuthi izinyathi ezijovwe ngohlobo lwegciwane i-SAT2 zazishesha ukuba nezinga lokushisa eliphakeme futhi isikhathi eside.
Hausa: Abin sha’awa shi ne, masu binciken sun gano cewa ɓaunaye da aka yiwa allura da nau’in ƙwayar cutar SAT2 na saurin samun zafin jiki mai yawa kuma na tsawon lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Sa go kgahliša, banyakišiši ba hweditše gore dinare tše di hlabetšwego ka mohuta wa baerase ya SAT2 di bile le themphereitšha ya godimo le dinako tše telele.
Amharic: የሚገርመው ነገር፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ በኤሰኤቲ2 ቫይረስ ዓይነት የተወጉ ጎሾች ፈጣን እና ረዘም ላለ ጊዜ ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን ላይ እንደሚገኙ ደርሰውበታል።

English: However, they did not find any relationship between increased temperature and viral loads (the amount of virus in the body).
Luganda: Wabula, tebaazuula kakwate konna wakati w’okweyongera kw’ebbugumu n’obungi bw’obuwuka (omuwendo gw’obuwuka mu mubiri).
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, wọn kò rí ìbáṣepọ̀ kankan láàrin ara gbígbóná àti ẹrù tí ó tànká (iye kòkòrò tí ó wà ní àgọ́ ara).
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, abazange bathole ubudlelwano phakathi kokukhuphuka kwezinga lokushisa kanye nenani legciwane egazini (inani legciwane emzimbeni).
Hausa: Duk da haka, ba su sami wata alaƙa a tsakanin ƙara yawan zafin jiki da yawan ƙwayoyin cuta ba (yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin jiki).
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, ga se ba hwetša kamano efe goba efe magareng ga themphereitšha ye e hlatlogilego le dikelo tša baerale (palo ka dibaerase mmeleng).
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ፣ በሙቀት መጨመር እና በቫይረስ ጭነቶች (በሰውነት ውስጥ ያለው የቫይረስ መጠን) መካከል ምንም ግንኙነት አላገኙም።

English: The researchers said they were able to detect FMDV in the injected buffaloes 2 days after injection, and after several days in the non-injected buffaloes.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti baasobola okuzuula akawuka k’obulwadde bwa FMDV mu mbogo ezaakubwamu obuwuka ennaku 2 oluvannyuma lw’okukubwamu, so nga kaazuulwa oluvannyuma lw’ennaku nnyingi mu mbogo ezitaakubwamu buwuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn sá ipá láti rí FMDV lára àwọn efọ̀n tí wọ́n fà á sí lára lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ méjì tí wọ́n gba abẹ́rẹ́ náà, àti lẹ́yìn ọjọ púpọ̀ lára àwọn ẹfọ̀n tí wọn ò gba abẹ́rẹ́ náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi bakwazile ukubona i-FMDV ezinyathini ezijovwe izinsuku ezi-2 ngemva kokujova, nangemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa ezinyathini ezingajoviwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sun sami damar gano FMDV a cikin ɓaunaye da aka yi wa allurar kwanaki 2 bayan allurar, da kuma bayan kwanaki da yawa a cikin ɓaunaye marasa allurar.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ba kgonne go lemoga FMDV go dinare tše di hlabetšwego tšhwaana matšatši a 2 morago ga go hlabelwa tšhwaana, le matšatši a mmalwa morago ga dinare tše di sa hlabelwago tšhwaana.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተወጉ ጎሾች ውስጥ ከተከተቡ ከ2 ቀናት በኋላውስጥ፣ እና ባልተከተቡ ጎሾች ውስጥ ከበርካታ ቀናት በኋላ ኤፍኤምዲቪን ማግኘት ችለናል ብለዋል።

English: The virus numbers reduced with time.
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’obuwuka gwakendeera ekiseera gye kyagenda kyeyongera.
Yoruba: Iye àwọn kòkòrò náà dínkù lẹ́yìn ìgbà díẹ̀.
Zulu: Izinombolo zegciwane ziyehla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
Hausa: Adadin ƙwayoyin cutar sun ragu da lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Palo ya dibaerase e fokotšegile ge nako e le gare e sepela.
Amharic: የቫይረሱ ቁጥር ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ ቀንሷል።

English: They also said that as soon as they noticed antibodies in the blood, FMDV had been cleared completely, meaning the immune system was able to fight the infection.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti amangu ddala nga baakalaba antibody mu musaayi, akawuka k’obulwadde bwa FMDV kaali kaggweereddemu ddala, ekitegeeza nti obusibage bwasobola okulwanyisa obuvune.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì tún sọ pé ní kété ti wọ́n ti kẹ́fín àwọn sójà ara nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀, FMDV ti di kíká kúrò pátápátá, èyí tí ó túmọ̀ sí pé àjesára ara kápa ìkórà náà.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi ngesikhathi bebona amasosha omzimba egazini, i-FMDV isisuswe ngokuphelele, okusho ukuthi amasosha omzimba ayakwazi ukulwa naleli gciwane.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce da zarar sun lura da ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki a cikin jini, an share FMDV gabaɗaya, ma’anasarin tgarkuwar jiki ta iya yaƙar cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše le gore morago ga gore ba lemoge dilwelammele ka mading a tšona, FMDV e lwantšhitšwe go felelela, se se šupa gore mašole a mmele e be e kgona go lwantšha phetetšo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በደም ውስጥ ያሉ ፀረ እንግዳ አካላትን እንዳዩ፣ ኤፍኤምዲቪ ሙሉ በሙሉ ተጠርጓል፣ ይህም ማለት በሽታ የመከላከል ስርዓቱ ኢንፌክሽኑን መዋጋት መቻሉን ተናግረዋል።

English: They said they did not observe any change in total white blood cell count in all buffaloes, but they reported possible swelling.
Luganda: Baagamba nti tebaalaba nkyukakyuka yonna mu muwendo gw’obutaffaali bw’omusaayi obweru mu mbogo zonna, naye waaliwo obusobozi bw’okuzimba.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní àwọn kò se àkíyèsí àyípadà kankan lára, òǹkà àpapọ̀ àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì ẹ̀jẹ̀ funfun lára gbogbo àwọn ẹfọ̀n pátápátá, àmọ́ mo wọ́n sọ nípa wíwú ara.
Zulu: Bathe ababonanga shintsho esilinganisweni samangqamuzana amhlophe egazi kuzo zonke izinyathi, kodwa babika ukuthi kungenzeka zivuvuke.
Hausa: Sun ce ba su lura da wani sauyi a jimlar adadin fararen ƙwayoyin jini a cikin duk ɓaunayen ba, amma sun bayar da rahoton yiwuwar kumburi.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ga se ba lemoga phetogo efe goba efe ka go palomoka ya kelo ya tša diselemadi tše tšhweu go dinare ka moka, eupša ba begile ka kgonagalo ya go ruruga.
Amharic: በሁሉም ጎሾች ውስጥ በአጠቃላይ የነጭ የደም ሴል ብዛት ላይ ምንም አይነት ለውጥ እንዳላዩ፣ ነገር ግን እብጠት ሊኖር እንደሚችል ተናግረዋል።

English: The body’s immune system produces white blood cells, or leukocytes, during an infection to help defend against the infection.
Luganda: Obusibage bw’omubiri bukola obutaffaali bwomusaayi obweru, oba leukocytes, mu kiseera ky’obuvune ne buyamba okulwanyisa obuvune.
Yoruba: Àjẹsára inú àgọ́ ara máa ń pèsè sẹ́ẹ́lì ẹ̀jẹ̀ funfun, tàbí hóró èjè tuntun, lásìkò ìkóràn tí ó ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti gbógun ti ìkóràn náà.
Zulu: Amasosha omzimba akhiqiza amangqamuzana egazi amhlophe, noma ama-leukocyte, ngesikhathi sokutheleleka ukusiza ukuvikela ukutheleleka.
Hausa: Tsarin garkuwar jiki yana samar da fararen ƙwayoyin jini, ko leukocytes, a yayin kamuwa da cuta domin taimakawa wajen kare kamuwa da cuta.
Northern Sotho: Mašole a mmele a tšweletša diselemadi tše tšhweu, goba lukhosaetse, nakong ya phetetšo go thuša go šireletša kgahlanong le phetetšo.
Amharic: የሰውነት በሽታ ተከላካይ ሕዋሳት ኢንፌክሽኑን ለመከላከል በሚረዱበት ጊዜ ነጭ የደም ሴሎችን፣ ወይም በሽታ ተከላካይ ነጭ የደም ህዋሳትን ያመነጫሉ።

English: They said their study was the first to show that African buffalo were indeed also affected by FMDV to an extent that they developed a high body temperature (fever).
Luganda: Baagamba nti okunoonyereza kwabwe kwe kwasooka okulaga nti embogo z’omu Africa nazo mu butuufu zifuna akawuka k’obulwadde bwa FMDV okutuuka ne kussa ly’okufuna ebbugumu eringi (omusujja).
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ìwádìí wọn ni àkọ́kọ́ tí yóò sàfihàn pé àwọn ẹfọ̀n ilè Áfíríkà náà fara gbá nínú FMDV dé ibi pé wọ́n ní ara gbígbóná (ibà).
Zulu: Bathe ucwaningo lwabo ngelokuqala olukhombisa ukuthi ngempela izinyathi zase-Afrika nazo zahlaselwa yi-FMDV kangangoba zaze zaba nokushisa komzimba okuphezulu (imfiva).
Hausa: Sun ce binciken da suka yi shi ne na farko da ya nuna cewa haƙiƙa FMDV yana kama ɓauna ta Afirka har ya kai ga kamuwa da zafin jiki mai yawa (zazzaɓi).
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore dinyakišišo tša bona e bile tša mathomo go bontšha gore nare ya Afrika le tšona di be di tloga di fetetšwe ke FMDV go fihla mo e lego gore di itemogetše themphereitšha ya godimo ya mmele (phišo ya mmele).
Amharic: ጥናታቸው የአፍሪካ ጎሽ በእርግጥም በኤፍኤምዲቪ ተጎድቶ ከፍተኛ የሰውነት ሙቀት (ትኩሳት) እስከሚከሰት ድረስ ያሳየ የመጀመሪያው ነው ብለዋል።

English: But, the researchers recommended more studies to understand why African buffaloes only get mild symptoms, unlike cattle.
Luganda: Naye, abanoonyereza baateesa wabeewo okunoonyereza okulala okutegeera lwaki embogo z’omu Africa zifuna obubonero butono, ekitali ku nte.
Yoruba: Àmọ́, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà dábàá ìwádìí síwájú síi láti lè lóye ìdí tí àwọn ẹfọ̀n ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà fi máa ń ní àmì àìsàn tí kò pọ̀, yàtọ̀ sí màlúù.
Zulu: Kodwa, abacwaningi bancome ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze baqonde ukuthi kungani izinyathi zase-Afrika zithola izimpawu ezithambile, ngokungafani nezinkomo.
Hausa: Amma, masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar ƙarin nazari domin fahimtar dalilin da ya sa ɓaunaye na Afirka kawai suke samun alamu matsakaita, saɓanin shanu.
Northern Sotho: Eupša, banyakišiši ba šišintše gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tše dingwe go kwešiša dinare tša Afrika fela go hwetša maswao a magareng, go fapana le dikgomo.
Amharic: ነገር ግን፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ የአፍሪካ ጎሾች ለምን፣ ከከብቶች በተለየ መልኩ፣ መለስተኛ ምልክቶችን ብቻ እንደሚያሳዩ ለመረዳት ተጨማሪ ጥናቶችን መክረዋል።

English: The researchers were based in South Africa and the USA.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baali bava mu South Africa ne mu USA.
Yoruba: Ilè South Africa àti USA ni àwọn aṣèwádìí náà fi ṣe ibùdó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebezinze eNingizimu Afrika nase-USA.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kasance a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma USA.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba etšwa ka Afrika Borwa le USA.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ መሰረታቸው በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በዩኤስኤ ነበር።
